title: Her father the railroad porter and her Cherokee grandfather
summary: Father worked as a train porter, mother stayed home with seven girls; grandmother Rachel Goodson and Cherokee grandfather who teased her to play piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
